globalLimits: Labels are editorial and do not establish manufacturer model codes.
Visible and not_shown describe the photograph, not the complete supplied product.
None of the fifteen kitchen photos shows an installed oven.
Do not infer cabinet colour from the global photo average: wall, floor, black frames and shadows dominate that value.
A photo-specific style should affect geometry and separate component finishes; kitchen layout compatibility remains a separate plan constraint.
A single picture does not prove these catalogue options fit the 6.22 × 11.80 m house or coexist with each other.
Patch colour is a photographed appearance, not RAL/NCS or a measured reflectance. Patterns lack physical scale.
